AboutMe.text: I am a Full Stack developer who turns ideas into fast, clear, and intuitive web experiences. I like to build up products from scratch, hunt down bugs, and clean up code until every detail falls into place. With over two years of experience, I keep learning, building, and solving problems without sacrificing design or performance.
AboutMe.pros: If production drops dead, I follow the logs, bring it back, and move on; the server can keep the drama.

swiftStake.name: Swift Stake
swiftStake.description: Swift Stake is a fast, secure staking platform that enables users to participate in decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols. The project integrates real-time APIs to provide current opportunities and rewards. With a focus on user experience and security, it simplifies earning passive income through blockchain technology.

restaurantFoodDelivery.name: Restaurant Food Delivery
restaurantFoodDelivery.description: Restaurant Food Delivery is a comprehensive food delivery platform that connects customers with local restaurants. Built with modern web technologies, it offers a seamless ordering experience with real-time tracking and a user-friendly interface.

chatbotAI.name: Chatbot AI
chatbotAI.description: Chatbot AI is an intelligent conversational assistant powered by the DeepSeek API and Next.js. It can answer questions, provide recommendations, and automate tasks. Its focus on natural-language understanding and a friendly interface brings the power of artificial intelligence to everyday interactions.
